pr_title: drivers: sensor: stm32 Vref sensor calibration on 12bit
pr_body:
The Calibration value of the VRef on stm32U5 is acquired on 14Bit by ADC1 and should be adjusted on 12bit becasue the resolution is 12bit in this stm32_vref driver.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/61368

Not evaluated against other stm32 series.
pr_comments:
The regex in the samples/sensor/soc_voltage/sample.yaml does not detect correctly the error
PASSED if the console output is 
```
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.4.0-2146-g24cd2ea1efd8 ***
Sensor voltage[vref_1]: 3.32 V
```

FAILED if the console output is 
```
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.4.0-2146-g24cd2ea1efd8 ***
Sensor voltage[vref_1]: 13.29 V
```

PASSED if the console output is 
```
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.4.0-2145-g29d07d6020eb ***
Sensor voltage[vref_1]: 13.29 V
Sensor voltage[vbat_4]: 3.30 V
```



On STM32U5, Vref resolution is 14-bit on ADC1, but 12-bit on ADC4. I believe your change will introduce an error for Vref measurement on ADC4.
Another more general solution would be to add a vrefint-resolution to st,stm32-vref.yaml, and using this property in the Vref driver instead of hard-coding the resolution to 12. The property would have a default value of 12, so that we don't have to define it everywhere, and would be set to 14 for ADC1 on U5.
> See my previous comment

![stm32U5_adc_vrefint](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/51417392/76ac5cec-00e7-41cf-91d6-9e695e8c45cd)

Actually, The VREFINT Calibration value is measured by the ADC1 on 14bit and stored in the system memory.
In case VREF is read on channel 0 of the AD4 (on 12-bits), the CALIBRATIon value is still given by the system memory and is still a 14-bit value. That must be  converted to a 12-bit value as long as the stm32_vref.c is setting a 12bit resolution.
![stm32_vref](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/51417392/3c8c72bb-d115-4f9f-8fe3-cbbc7e079835)

issue_context.title: STM32 b_u585i_iot02a, reading vrefint problem
issue_context.body:
*
**Describe the bug**
I tried sample, samples\sensor\soc_voltage.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. west build -p auto -b b_u585i_iot02a samples\sensor\soc_voltage
2. west flash
3. see error

**Expected behavior**
Should vref_1 be around 1,2 V ? ADC1 channel 0.

**Impact**
Minor

**Logs and console output**

*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.4.0-2226-g4cbb9d8f5f46 ***
Sensor voltage[vref_1]: 13.20 V
Sensor voltage[vbat_4]: 3.32 V

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS:Windows
 - Toolchain Zephyr SDK, 0.16.1
 - latest codes from github

**Additional context**
comments:
The error comes form the VREF int calibration value which is 14bit and has to be converted to 12bit value when the ADC channel is measured on 12 bits.

![vref _stm32U5](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/51417392/0af54767-95d3-4c35-a841-97cdba44606b)

review_comments: Is there a way to get this information from device tree (`resolution` property) ?
Not really, this is a specific value of the stm32U5 given by the datasheet when the internal voltage reference is calibrated ; not related to the ADC resolution
